lines.en: Slowly gnaws at the cave wall.
It crawls upside down across the cave ceiling.
A long shadow drags through the crevices.
It molts quietly deep in the stone.
It counts the dripping of the cave.
It rests against the damp cave wall.
It grows slowly in the dark.

lines.zh: 跟着你，一步都不会落下。
lines.en: I follow you and never fall a step behind.

lines.zh: 从岩缝里抬起许多眼睛
lines.en: Many eyes lift out of the crevice.
It knows how deep you have dug.
Its pupils shrink in the cave chill.

lines.zh: 它把你的火把记在心里

lines.en: Its gaze crawls toward you along the floor.
A third eye opens in the dark.
It measures how much deeper you will go.
Its stare is colder than the cave.
You feel watched straight through the stone.
Its eyeballs roll inside the skull.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中发出低吼，声音沙哑。
你感觉到一阵刺痛，如同被冰针扎了。
它的触手缠住了你，让你无法动弹。
它靠近你，露出锋利的牙齿。
你的皮肤被腐蚀得疼痛难忍。
你感到一阵剧痛，如被巨石砸中。
它喷出一团毒液，灼烧你的皮肤。
黑暗中传来一阵低沉的咆哮。
你被它的角顶住了，喘不过气。
你靠近我，便等同于挑战！
品尝我的肉，感受痛苦的滋味！
lines.en: Taste my flesh, feel the pain!

lines.zh: 你的存在对我毫无意义！
品尝我的痛苦，这便是你的宿命！
lines.en: Suffer my pain, this is your fate!

lines.zh: 你就是我的猎物，永远无法逃脱！
lines.en: You are my prey, forever lost!

lines.zh: 陷入我的诅咒，你将永无安宁！
lines.en: Fall under my curse, find no peace!

lines.zh: 你是我的，永远无法逃离！
你的死亡将滋养我的力量！
你的力量对我无能为力！

lines.en: Your force is useless on me!

lines.zh: 你的碰撞只会徒增痛苦！

lines.en: Come to me, I'll give you power!

lines.zh: 与我结合，共享我的力量！
lines.en: Mate with me, share my strength!

lines.zh: 你的同伴会成为我的食粮！
lines.en: Your companions will be my food!

lines.zh: 我的伴侣将统治这片土地！
lines.en: My mate will rule this land!

lines.zh: 你的同类将融入我的血肉！
lines.en: Your kind will become my flesh!

lines.zh: 我们的力量将合而为一！
lines.en: Our powers will merge into one!

lines.zh: 与我结合，共享我的永生！
lines.en: Mate with me, share eternal life!

lines.zh: 你的同类将被我们吞噬！
lines.en: Your kind will be consumed by us!

lines.zh: 我的力量将通过你传递！
lines.en: My power will flow through you!

lines.zh: 与我结合，你将成为我的一部分！
lines.en: Mate with me, you'll be part of me!

lines.zh: 岩浆在它身上燃烧，但别靠近！
lines.en: Lava burns on its skin, but stay back!

lines.zh: 我从没见过这么丑的生物！
lines.en: I've never seen such a grotesque creature!

lines.zh: 它的触手似乎永无止境...
它的身体在黑暗中发光!
lines.en: Its body glows in the darkness!
This thing seems afraid of light!

lines.zh: 它的叫声仿佛来自深渊!
lines.en: Its scream echoes from the depths!
Its shadow writhes on the wall.

lines.zh: 它的洞穴中充满了危险.
lines.en: Its caves are full of danger.

lines.zh: 我已经盯上你了，地下之子...
lines.en: I've got my eye on you, son of the earth...

lines.zh: 你的命运将在 tonight 完结...
你的死亡将比想象中更快...
lines.en: Your death will be faster than you think...
Today is your day of reckoning...

lines.zh: 你将永远留在我的记忆中...
lines.en: You'll be remembered in my memory...
You have stepped into my stratum.
The deeper you go, the faster I am.

lines.zh: 这块岩壁记得你的味道。

lines.en: I have waited a thousand nights here.

lines.zh: 你挖开的洞就是我的门。
lines.en: The hole you dug is my doorway.
Do not look back. I am behind you.

lines.zh: 我在你影子里数着步数。
lines.en: I count your steps inside your shadow.

lines.zh: 你跑得越快，我长得越大。
lines.en: The faster you run, the larger I grow.

lines.zh: 往深处跑吧，我在下面等着。
lines.en: Run deeper; I am waiting below.
A little farther lies my nest.
I have learned the sound of your steps.
Even turning back, you will find no exit.
I will see you to the end of this road.

lines.zh: 地底的黑暗站在我这边。
lines.en: The dark below takes my side.

lines.zh: 你听见的喘息不是你的。
lines.en: That breathing you hear is not yours.

lines.zh: 它的爪子撕裂了你的皮肤！
lines.en: Its claws tear through your skin!
You feel its sharp teeth approaching!

lines.zh: 它的触手缠住了你的脚踝！
lines.en: Its tentacles wrap around your ankles!

lines.zh: 它用刺针刺中了你的弱点！
lines.en: Its needles pierce your weak spot!

lines.zh: 你被它的利爪狠狠地划伤了！
lines.en: Its claws slash at you harshly!

lines.zh: 它的触须缠绕住你，无法动弹！
lines.en: Its tendrils bind you, unable to move!

lines.zh: 你感受到了它的黏液附着在皮肤上！
lines.en: Its slime clings to your skin!

lines.zh: 它的毒刺深深刺入你的肌肉！
lines.en: Its venomous spines pierce your flesh!

lines.zh: 它的触手撕扯你的衣物！
它的爪子在黑暗中闪烁着寒光！
lines.en: Its claws gleam with cold light in the dark!
Stone spikes burst from under your feet!
Its long fingers sink into your shoulder!
The walls close in and pin you!
Its teeth are like shattered quartz!
It bites clean through your torch!
The rock splits, and it appears!

lines.zh: 洞穴深处传来它的低吟！
lines.en: A low growl comes from the depths!

lines.zh: 地面突然隆起，它现身了！
lines.en: The ground rumbles, and it appears!

lines.zh: 你听到它在岩壁后低语！
lines.en: You hear it whisper behind the rock!

lines.zh: 它的影子在洞穴中游走！
lines.en: Its shadow moves through the cavern!

lines.zh: 你感觉它的存在，在洞穴中！
lines.en: You feel its presence in the cavern!

lines.zh: 它从地下深处缓缓爬出！
lines.en: It crawls out of the deep underground!

lines.zh: 它从黑暗中无声地出现！
lines.en: It silently appears from the darkness!

lines.zh: 它的存在扭曲了周围的光线！
lines.en: Its presence warps the surrounding light!

lines.zh: 它悄无声息地出现在你面前！
你的镐敲到了活的石头。

lines.en: Your lamp lights up a face.
The puddle at the bottom flows backward.
Something molts deep in the rock.

lines.zh: 你身后的矿道多了一条影子。
lines.en: A second shadow joins your tunnel.
It stands up out of the cave-in.
A pair of eyes joins the dark.

lines.zh: 你从高处摔下，撞击声震耳欲聋。
水下传来它的嘶嘶声，冰冷刺骨。
爆炸的冲击波撕裂你的皮肤。
它的魔法击中你，让你感觉虚弱。
饥饿让你感到虚弱，几乎失去意识。
虚空侵蚀你的存在，痛苦无比。
